d:
BJP has emerged as the biggest winner in the MLC Election Result 2026 across four states.
However, defeats in Varanasi and Patna have raised questions for the BJP leadership.
In Varanasi, Samajwadi Party’s Lal Bihari Yadav defeated BJP’s Pramod Kumar Mishra in the Teachers’ MLC seat. In Patna, RJD’s Sanjeev Singh defeated BJP’s Dr. Nawal Kishore Yadav on a seat held by BJP for nearly 30 years.
Here’s why these two defeats could matter more than several of BJP’s victories in the MLC elections.
